title: Spotify client secret in a Basic envelope
summary: A synthetic encoded credential after the Basic scheme in the Authorization header of a token request, in a raw request, a quoted curl -H argument and a JSON header map. The encoded value is the base64 of a synthetic client id and a synthetic client secret joined by a colon.
rationale: Spotify documents that the token request carries the base64 encoding of the client id and client secret in a Basic Authorization header. The secret exists only inside the encoded credential, so the extent is the whole encoded token, not a decoded secret-only span. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width of the secret. The Basic scheme is generic, so the attribution stays generic. The client id is public.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the encoded credential after the Basic scheme in a token request to Spotify is treated as a credential and covered whole. Spotify documents the Basic envelope of client id and client secret (carrier existence only); the extent, value admission and generic attribution are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: Authorization Required Base 64 encoded string that contains the client ID and client secret key. The field must have the format: Authorization: Basic <base64 encoded client_id:client_secret>
